Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right-hand lane of the access road near Katy, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was
struck by a sedan operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee at the scene and was transported for
evaluation. The knee complaint is conisstent with the mechanism of a rear impact in which the lower body braces
against the footwell, and the damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assembly matches the impact
described by both drivers. Responding officres saw no earlier damage to either vehicle that would suggest a prior
loss. The Passenger, seated in the front right seat, was present in the vehicle at the time of impact, and this was
confirmed by officers on scene and by statements from both drivers. Scene photographs document several of the
reported conditions, although no independent witnesses came forward and no one else observed the collision. Driver
1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
</page>
